description: This file defines and exports a CSSStyleSheet instance with a set of global CSS styles applied via replaceSync. The styles include box-sizing, margin, padding, font, background, focus styles, button and input styling, placeholder styling, visually-hidden class, and truncate-singleline class.

methods.name: replaceSync
methods.description: Method called on the CSSStyleSheet instance to synchronously replace its content with the provided CSS rules.
